evidence_kind.description: What it rests on: attach the file with addOwnerSuccessionEvidence before it is completed.

reason.description: Why the Owner is permanently unavailable: departure, incapacity or death, and what was decided. The outgoing Owner and every Owner read it.
examples: Ben left the company on 31 October; the board resolved on his removal

successor_member_id.description: A member who becomes an Owner when it completes, such as a new director, so the company keeps two Owners; leave it out to name none.
